goal1Label.title: Label
goal1Label.description: Shown on the bar, for example Followers.

goal1Title.title: Reward line (optional)
goal1Title.description: What happens at the goal, for example Face cam on!

goal1Sources.title: Adds up
goal1Sources.description: Every ticked item counts toward this goal. Gifted subs, Bits and gifts count their amount; Super Chats and tips count whole currency units.

goal1RaiseBy.title: Raise the target by
goal1RaiseBy.description: When the total is reached, the target goes up by this much. 0 = off.

goal1Start.title: Starting count
goal1Start.description: Added to the total, for example your follower count today.
